name: Quick Actions & Clock
description: Shared Home Assistant action rail and optional clock across the Kiosk dashboard, screensavers and Fotoo; Party Mode hidden by default.
author: Local Kiosk Satellite project

settings.title: Show on
settings.description: Choose which screensavers show the action rail; dashboard visibility is configured separately.

settings.title: Quick actions on dashboard
settings.description: Show the same configured actions over the foreground Kiosk dashboard. No duplicate Lovelace configuration.

settings.title: Quick actions in Party Mode
settings.description: Normally hidden. Explicitly enable to show actions in Party Mode.

settings.title: Clock on dashboard
settings.description: Optional independent clock. For a single clock on Kiosk screensavers, disable the built-in clock before enabling this one. The plugin clock is always hidden in Party Mode.

settings.title: Clock on Kiosk screensaver
settings.description: Optional independent clock. For a single clock on Kiosk screensavers, disable the built-in clock before enabling this one. The plugin clock is always hidden in Party Mode.

settings.title: Clock on Fotoo
settings.description: Optional independent clock. For a single clock on Kiosk screensavers, disable the built-in clock before enabling this one. The plugin clock is always hidden in Party Mode.

settings.title: Show clock date
settings.description: Optional independent clock. For a single clock on Kiosk screensavers, disable the built-in clock before enabling this one. The plugin clock is always hidden in Party Mode.

settings.title: Position
settings.description: Anchor point for the action rail.

settings.title: Layout
settings.description: Stack actions vertically or horizontally.

settings.title: Picture size
settings.description: Avatar/icon size for each item.

settings.title: Spacing
settings.description: Space between items.

settings.title: Opacity
settings.description: Opacity of the action rail.

settings.title: Show names and states
settings.description: Show friendly name and current state beside the picture.
